csv_agency: State of Tennessee Department of General Services
csv_scope_of_work: The State of Tennessee, Department of General Services, State of Tennessee Real Estate Asset Management ( STREAM ), hereinafter referred to as the State, has issued this Request for Proposals ( RFP ), to define minimum contract requirements; solicit responses; detail response requirements; and, outline the State s process for evaluating responses and selecting a Construction Manager/General Contractor ( CM/GC ), to provide the needed services. The conservation hall work is to include replacement of the existing audio/ visual equipment, improving the kitchen hood exhaust, and the elevator scope of work as noted in the main residence scope. Wood deck and trim repair/replacement, soffit repair, HVAC upgrades, and Interior/exterior painting is also needed within the carriage house. Foundation/slab on grade/masonry wall structural remediation, and exterior painting is needed on the maintenance shop. HVAC/plumbing and electrical updates in the pool house. Lastly, the existing irrigation system will need new heads, controls, and expansion as well as the campus fire alarm replacement due to existing system no longer being supported
csv_disciplines_requested: Design Build/Developer, Construction/Project Management, Cost Estimating

title: CM/GC for Tennessee Residence Update
short_description: CM/GC services for renovation and systems upgrades at the Tennessee Residence campus.
project_scope: Renovation and upgrade works at the Tennessee Residence campus, including conservation hall audio/visual replacement, kitchen hood exhaust improvements, elevator-related work in the main residence, wood deck and trim repair/replacement, soffit repair, HVAC upgrades, interior/exterior painting in the carriage house, foundation/slab-on-grade/masonry wall structural remediation and exterior painting at the maintenance shop, HVAC/plumbing/electrical updates in the pool house, irrigation system head/control expansion, and campus fire alarm replacement.
services: Construction Manager/General Contractor (CM/GC) services; disciplines requested include design-build/developer, construction/project management, and cost estimating.
relevance_explanation:
- Primarily a renovation package for residential/support buildings with limited structural ambition.
- Scope is dominated by MEP, finishes, repairs, and CM/GC services rather than structural design.
- Only minor structural remediation is mentioned; no notable spans, special structures, or lightweight concepts.
- Low strategic fit for sbp compared with bridges, long-span roofs, stadiums, or complex building structures.
construction_cost_explanation: Taken from the tender documents: Total Construction Cost $3.4M.
fee_explanation: No explicit planning or engineering fee stated in the tender documents. The procurement is for CM/GC services, not a separate structural engineering fee.
references_qualifications: Minimum contract requirements are to be defined in the RFP. The notice indicates participation goals for Minority-Owned Business Enterprise, Small Business Enterprise, Woman-Owned Business Enterprise, and Service Disabled Veteran Owned Small Business. No specific technical reference requirements are stated in the provided text.
